chunks.text: Rohit's full name is Ranga Rohit Nallamolu. Rohit is a Data Engineer based in Dallas, TX, with 3+ years building data pipelines that power analytics and AI.

chunks.title: Current role

chunks.text: Rohit currently works as a Data Engineer at BigBlue InfoTech, on the client McKesson, in Dallas, TX (January 2025 to present). The work covers PySpark ELT pipelines on Databricks, Kafka streaming into Delta Lake, finance data marts, data quality automation, and Power BI dashboards for finance leadership.

chunks.text: Rohit has 3+ years of data engineering experience: Data Engineer at BigBlue InfoTech for McKesson since January 2025, and before that Graduate Data Engineer (Dec 2022 to May 2024) and Graduate Research Assistant (Jun 2023 to Nov 2023) at UMass Lowell.

chunks.text: Yes. Rohit is open to Data Engineering roles and is based in Dallas, TX. The quickest way to reach Rohit is n.rangarohit@gmail.com or +1 978 569 7460, or the Message button in this chat.

chunks.title: Strengths
chunks.keywords: why hire strengths strong best good at fit value bring impact results achievements accomplishments highlights proud
chunks.text: Rohit's strengths are building reliable batch and streaming pipelines and proving their impact: cutting month-end close prep time by 20%, lowering Databricks compute cost by 15%, and saving 40+ hours of manual work per month with automated checks and Power BI dashboards. Rohit also brings hands-on AI work, with Claude classification inside pipelines, RAG and text-to-SQL apps, and a multi-agent stock research platform.

chunks.text: Rohit builds dashboards in Power BI. At McKesson, Rohit delivered P&L, OPEX, and headcount dashboards to finance leadership, replacing Excel reports and saving 25+ hours per month. At UMass Lowell, Rohit created enrollment, course performance, and tuition revenue dashboards for department leaders. Rohit also works with SAP Analytics Cloud.

chunks.title: Professional summary
chunks.keywords: who about summary introduction background overview profile data engineer yourself
chunks.text: Ranga Rohit Nallamolu is a Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable batch and streaming pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, Databricks, Kafka, and cloud platforms. Rohit is experienced in Delta Lake, CDC, dimensional modeling, workflow orchestration, CI/CD, and automated data quality. Rohit optimizes data processing, improves pipeline reliability, and delivers financial and operational data for analytics and AI-driven insights.

chunks.title: Why data
chunks.keywords: why motivation journey story passion interest career path analytics
chunks.text: Rohit has always been drawn to data, especially the challenge of turning messy, disconnected information into something a business can act on. That curiosity pulled Rohit from analytics into data engineering. More recently it led to building agentic AI systems that can reason over data on their own.

chunks.title: Data Engineer · BigBlue InfoTech (Client: McKesson)
chunks.keywords: current job role work company employer mckesson mckesson bigblue responsibilities day dallas texas finance headcount pipelines elt databricks pyspark kafka streaming real-time 2025 present
chunks.text: Since January 2025, Rohit has worked as a Data Engineer at BigBlue InfoTech for the client McKesson in Dallas, TX. Rohit engineered PySpark ELT pipelines on Databricks for finance, headcount, and operational data, cutting month-end close prep time by 20%. Rohit also developed Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming pipelines that ingest real-time operational events into Delta Lake with checkpointing.

chunks.title: Data quality & reconciliation at McKesson
chunks.keywords: data quality checks validation reconciliation nulls duplicates schema drift freshness source target testing reliability mckesson
chunks.text: At McKesson, Rohit automated data validation and source-to-target reconciliation for nulls, duplicates, schema drift, and freshness, saving 16+ hours per month.

chunks.title: Spark performance tuning at McKesson
chunks.keywords: spark optimization performance tuning partitioning caching cost reduction runtime compute databricks p&l opex headcount mckesson
chunks.text: Rohit optimized P&L, OPEX, and headcount Spark jobs at McKesson with partitioning and caching, cutting job runtime and Databricks compute costs by 15%.

chunks.title: Data marts & orchestration at McKesson
chunks.keywords: data modeling marts actuals budget forecast headcount merge cdc variance airflow databricks workflows retries alerting github actions ci/cd dbt tests orchestration deploy
chunks.text: At McKesson, Rohit modeled actuals, budget, forecast, and headcount data marts in Delta Lake using MERGE and CDC loads for variance reporting. Rohit orchestrated Airflow and Databricks Workflows with retries and alerting, using GitHub Actions CI/CD and dbt tests for reliable deploys.

chunks.title: Power BI & Claude at McKesson
chunks.keywords: power bi dashboards finance leadership excel reports p&l opex headcount claude api sentiment product feedback review marts genai llm mckesson
chunks.text: Rohit delivered Power BI dashboards for P&L, OPEX, and headcount to McKesson finance leadership, replacing Excel reports and saving 25+ hours per month. Rohit also applied the Claude API on Databricks to tag sentiment and recurring issues in product feedback, loading the results into review data marts.

chunks.title: Graduate Data Engineer · UMass Lowell
chunks.keywords: umass lowell university graduate data engineer student enrollment course finance azure data factory legacy medallion data lake reporting 2022 2024
chunks.text: From December 2022 to May 2024, Rohit was a Graduate Data Engineer at the University of Massachusetts Lowell. Rohit ingested student, enrollment, course, and finance data from legacy systems with Azure Data Factory and PySpark on Databricks, then structured it into raw, cleaned, and business-ready Medallion layers on Azure Data Lake, cutting reporting time by 25%.

chunks.title: Modeling, tuning & governance at UMass Lowell
chunks.keywords: star schema scd type 2 dimensions enrollment history retention predicate pushdown z-ordering compaction data quality completeness accuracy unity catalog rbac governance security permissions umass
chunks.text: At UMass Lowell, Rohit designed star-schema models with SCD Type 2 dimensions to preserve enrollment history for retention and revenue analysis. Rohit tuned Spark pipelines with predicate pushdown, Z-ordering, and file compaction, reducing runtime by 10%, introduced automated checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, and duplicates, and secured sensitive student data with Databricks Unity Catalog and RBAC.

chunks.title: Power BI at UMass Lowell
chunks.keywords: power bi dashboards enrollment course performance tuition revenue department leaders reporting umass
chunks.text: Rohit created Power BI dashboards at UMass Lowell for enrollment, course performance, and tuition revenue, presenting insights to department leaders.

chunks.title: Graduate Research Assistant · UMass Lowell
chunks.keywords: research assistant healthcare metagenomics microbiome azure data lake databricks pyspark 12 years ml-ready dataset 2023
chunks.text: From June 2023 to November 2023, Rohit was a Graduate Research Assistant at UMass Lowell. Rohit consolidated 12 years of metagenomics data from Azure Data Lake into an ML-ready dataset using PySpark on Azure Databricks.

chunks.title: Diabetes risk models
chunks.keywords: machine learning random forest xgboost pytorch neural network type 2 diabetes prediction model accuracy coprococcus correlation healthcare
chunks.text: In the research role, Rohit built XGBoost, Random Forest, and PyTorch neural network models in Python to predict Type 2 diabetes risk, achieving 85% test accuracy. The work identified a strong positive correlation (r = 0.70) between Coprococcus bacteria abundance and Type 2 diabetes risk.

chunks.title: AI-Powered Food Delivery Analytics Pipeline
chunks.keywords: food delivery analytics pipeline project airflow s3 snowflake dbt medallion merge facts orders 10m daily batch side
chunks.text: The AI-Powered Food Delivery Analytics Pipeline is a project where Rohit architected a daily Airflow pipeline that loads 10M orders from S3 into Snowflake, with dbt medallion layers and MERGE facts. The code is on GitHub at github.com/rangarohitnallamolu/food-delivery-analytics-pipeline.

chunks.title: Food delivery reviews: Claude, RAG & text-to-SQL
chunks.keywords: food delivery reviews claude classification sentiment topic key issue dbt insights mart rag chat text-to-sql streamlit natural language customer feedback business metrics
chunks.text: In the food delivery project, Rohit automated Claude classification of 300K reviews by sentiment, topic, and key issue as a step in the Airflow DAG, feeding a dbt insights mart. Rohit also built RAG chat and text-to-SQL Streamlit applications for natural-language exploration of customer feedback and business metrics.

chunks.title: StockSense · AI stock trading & research platform
chunks.keywords: stocksense stock trading research platform ai agents multi-agent claude haiku sonnet bull bear debate risk stop-loss project side
chunks.text: StockSense is an AI-driven stock trading and research platform Rohit built for data-backed stock research, where Claude Haiku and Sonnet Bull/Bear agents debate each trade idea. Automated daily research and risk/stop-loss checks on 100+ stocks cut evaluation time by 90% and manual monitoring by about 80%. It is live at stocksense-rangarohit.vercel.app.

chunks.title: StockSense architecture
chunks.keywords: architecture stack nextjs next.js node.js nodejs postgresql aws cognito rds finnhub fmp market data apis
chunks.text: StockSense is built with Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS, Cognito), using live market data from the Finnhub and FMP APIs.

chunks.title: AI, LLM & RAG experience
chunks.keywords: ai artificial intelligence llm genai generative rag retrieval augmented agentic agents claude api chatbot pytorch xgboost streamlit this assistant
chunks.text: Rohit's AI/ML toolkit includes Claude, RAG, PyTorch, XGBoost, and Streamlit. Rohit has used the Claude API on Databricks to tag product feedback at McKesson, Claude classification inside an Airflow pipeline with RAG chat and text-to-SQL apps in the food delivery project, and Claude Bull/Bear agents in StockSense. The assistant on this page is itself a small RAG pipeline: Rohit's profile is chunked into a knowledge base, retrieved with BM25 and fuzzy matching, and turned into a grounded answer.

chunks.text: Rohit applied deep learning to classify multi-label ocular diseases on an 8,000-image dataset, comparing VGGNet, ResNet, DenseNet, and InceptionNet. InceptionNet performed best with 60% accuracy and 0.76 AUC.

chunks.title: Image caption generator with accessibility
chunks.keywords: image captioning cnn rnn lstm flickr8k nlp accessibility visually impaired speech bleu
chunks.text: Rohit built an image caption generator that uses a CNN for image features and an LSTM to generate captions, trained on Flickr 8k. It reached a BLEU score of 0.35 and converts captions to speech for people with visual impairments.

chunks.text: Rohit studied semantic and keyword data-poisoning attacks on MNIST and spam/ham classifiers, then built an adversarial-training defense that improved robustness by 20% on MNIST and 8% on the spam/ham model.
